mu_name_from: MODEL_DARK_HORSE_ITEM, MODEL_HELPER+4: AccessModel(MODEL_DARK_HORSE_ITEM, L"Data\\Item\\", L"DarkHorseHorn") (ZzzOpenData.cpp:719), its sheets from Skill\ and then Item\ (:1296-1297): the horse's own dkhead2 and dkheadwing. ITEM_DARK_HORSE_ITEM, group 13 number 4 (_enum.h:2705), named "Dark Horse" (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Pets.cs:66). The bag icon; the ridden horse is DarkHorse.
profile_note: A small held object seen in the bag: the weapon profile, as every misc item.
sheet_from: The horse's own two sheets (Data/Skill/dkhead2.OZJ and dkheadwing.OZJ, 32x32, opaque): its head plate, dark blue enamel edged in gold.
sheet_materials_from: The horse's head barding, enamelled plate. Judged from the sheets.
chrome_from: RenderPartObjectBody's MODEL_DARK_HORSE_ITEM arm (ZzzObject.cpp:7130-7135): the body, then the whole body again RENDER_BRIGHT | RENDER_CHROME under BodyLight (0.8, 0.4, 0.1), no image bound, so each mesh's own sheet at RENDER_CHROME's coordinates added in orange (`own`). At 0.4 where MU draws 1, as the horse's. pipeline/chrome_sheets.py.

stats.note: The item's own row, from OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser: the Dark Horse is the Dark Lord's (0.99+), not 0.75's. **After 0.75**, marked.
stats.call: this.CreatePet(4, SkillNumber.Earthshake, 1, 1, "Dark Horse", 218, false, false, (Stats.IsHorseEquipped, 1, AddRaw), (Stats.MovementSpeed, HorseOrFenrirMovementSpeed, Maximum), (Stats.MovementSpeedUnderwater, ...)); QualifiedCharacters AllLords; MaximumItemLevel 50
stats.requires_note: 218 is the row's; the realm asks 218 + 2 a horse level (WebZen zzzitem.cpp:580-583, MuMain GIPetManager.cpp:684-686), and a horse is born level 1 (zzzitem.cpp:95), so 220 (sim::asks).
stats.classes_note: The Dark Lord's alone (CreatePet's AllLords; MuMain's card, GIPetManager.cpp:731-732).
stats.power_note: Ridden in the mount's slot (sim::placeOf). While it has life: defence + 5 + Agility/20 + 2 a level (WebZen ObjCalCharacter.cpp:1082-1090), and every blow taken costs the rider 1 life and is cut to (100 - (30 + level)/2)% -- 85% at level 1, 60% at 50 (ObjAttack.cpp:1345-1361). It wears by damage x 2/10 / 10 + 1 a hit taken into a tally, a point of life each 1500 (user.cpp:10632-10650); dead at 0, not destroyed. It carries Earthshake, skill 62 (zzzitem.cpp:1026-1030), not built yet.
stats.price_note: 2,000,000 a horse level, a third back (WebZen CItem::PetValue, zzzitem.cpp; sim::buyingPrice). Made at the Pet Trainer from a Spirit in MU (MixSystem.cpp:3051-3245); not made or sold here yet.
